evidence_boundaries: The Zhu paper contains measured EUV spectra and plume imaging, while the quoted temperature, density, and mean charge are LTE, Gaussian-geometry, and radiative-transfer inversion results rather than independent direct probes.
The IFMIF formal metadata corresponds to a Nuclear Fusion article, but the locally validated full text is the QST institutional author/conference manuscript rather than the IOP version of record.
The IFMIF beam and lithium-loop results are component and pulsed-beam achievements; the 9 MeV, 125 mA continuous-wave, 1.125 MW end-to-end target remains unvalidated.

The IFMIF manuscript text renders a neutron yield as 3.2e5 per deuteron, but its following 125 mA to 3e13 n/s projection is consistent only with approximately 3.8e-5 per deuteron; this is recorded as an unresolved likely missing-minus-sign issue.

The Parisi paper is an OpenMC, nuclear-data, depletion, and supply-scenario preprint; its dose-equivalent values are not treated-patient counts, measured production yields, or an operating isotope supply chain.
No Cowan, SpeIma3D, beam-dynamics, MCNP6, OpenMC, thermal-hydraulic, shielding, or radiochemical-separation model was rerun locally.
